brief: The lane's MORNING. The clock button's second landing (sunUp + 0.5, one tap away) shows the sweeper, the cart from ~sunUp + 0.2 and nobody else — the watch line says so and nobody has built for that hour. The lane has had no shipped work since #74. Give it a morning round: ONE figure with a handcart or a bag who comes in at the west end at sunUp − 0.3 and works the HOME_DOORS (y 64; x 4..130, fourteen doors) in order, a short stop at each (a bottle or a parcel left on the step: one small draw per delivered door, visible at 3×, cleared by ~09:30 as if taken in), out by the east end by sunUp + 1.6; its own source beside the sweeper's spawn (~line 3481: `!sweeper && hour > sunUp − 0.5 …`), NEVER a laneCap share; goes in rain under an umbrella (a.umbrella exists), skips only when snow is lying (snowCover > 0.5). Price the round first: fourteen stops must fit 1.9 h at effective speed ~0.75·a.speed — trace one; if it does not fit, fewer doors, not a faster walker. Second clause, the one a wide shot reads: the HOMES' windows are lit before sunrise — from sunUp − 0.8 fading out by sunUp + 0.4 — through windowLit()/LIT_PANES exactly as the evening does (check first whether a dawn is ALREADY lit by the nid mechanism; if it is, count it, say so, and spend the time on the round). Names: personName 'the morning round' / nameAt on a step 'a bottle left on the step'; the morning lapse's landing line names the round when it is out.
seams: probes/night-lit.mjs or the nearest LIT probe (ls probes/)
successLooksLike: probes/morning-round.mjs, 10 seeds × 4 days: the round is out on every non-snow day, in at sunUp − 0.3 ± 0.1, all fourteen doors visited, out by sunUp + 1.6 (a summer and a winter day both — the sunAt law); the morning lapse lands at sunUp + 0.5 with the round mid-street on 10/10 seeds; step marks present at 07:30 and gone at 09:30 in a 3× crop; dawn panes lit at sunUp − 0.5 and dark at sunUp + 0.5 on the same seed; census PASS (one new agent kind: people +1 at most per instant); motion PASS; filmstrip of the morning lapse 0 POP.
avoid: No laneCap share. Do not move the sweeper or the cart. Do not change the lapse landing hour. Do not add a second figure — one round, priced.
